name: (DUSTDUST BOSS FIX!!!!!) Random Code Soul Ops Rush
desc:
Great news! 
The project has been retaken!
Development is back and a SOMETHING is currently in progress.
------------------------------
Random Code Soul Ops is a fangame made to give players a fun, co-op experience in the Soul Ops universe.
------------------------------
How to Play:
• Defend the Six Human Souls:
Protect them while fighting tough bosses from different timelines.
• Team Up:
Work with other players to take down strong enemies and win.
------------------------------
Credits:
Big thanks to Oyun & Chicken for making the original Soul Ops game.
Big thanks to Dapper_Noob for making all the sprites.
------------------------------
💬 Join the official comms server to stay updated on the new development!
